verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's Cocoa library reference says it automatically reports crashes and errors in your app, which gives first-party but thinly documented iOS crash capture. Nothing in the pack covers Android, NDK, or the device, OS, and app-version context the story requires. missing for 10: Android crash capture, NDK/native C/C++ crash capture, documented device/OS/app-version context on crash reports, symbolication details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture native mobile crashes — iOS, Android, NDK — with the device, OS, and app-version context needed to reproduce them

citations.quote: Once installed, Honeybadger will automatically report crashes and errors in your app.
